lint.source:
lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

    - name: Setup Tools
      uses: ./.github/actions/setup-tools

    - name: Setup NPM packages
      uses: ./.github/actions/setup-npm

    - name: Run lint
      run: pnpm lint

access-router-minimum-node-smoke.source:
access-router-minimum-node-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

    - name: Pin minimum access-router Node version
      run: |
        printf 'nodejs 24.0.0\npython 3.14.6\npnpm 11.21.0\n' > .tool-versions

    - name: Setup Tools
      uses: ./.github/actions/setup-tools

    - name: Setup NPM packages
      uses: ./.github/actions/setup-npm

    - name: Run access-router packed consumer smoke
      run: |
        mkdir -p _tmp-node24-access-router
        git check-ignore _tmp-node24-access-router
        export TMPDIR="$PWD/_tmp-node24-access-router"
        node --version
        pnpm --version
        pnpm --filter @web-ts-toolkit/access-router... build
        pnpm --filter @web-ts-toolkit/access-router exec vitest run --config vitest.contracts.config.ts test/contracts/packed-consumer-compatibility.test.ts --testNamePattern "supports minimum peers from release-artifact tarballs across ESM, CJS, NodeNext, and Bundler consumers"

access-router-react-minimum-node.source:
access-router-react-minimum-node:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        lane: [supported, floating]
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.lane == 'floating' }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

    - name: Setup build tools
      uses: ./.github/actions/setup-tools

    - name: Setup NPM packages
      uses: ./.github/actions/setup-npm

    - name: Install library runtime floor
      run: asdf install nodejs 24.0.0

    - name: Build installed consumer artifacts
      run: pnpm --filter @web-ts-toolkit/access-router-react... build

    - name: Verify both React majors on Node 24.0.0
      env:
        ACCESS_ROUTER_REACT_EXPECT_NODE: 24.0.0
        ACCESS_ROUTER_REACT_FLOATING: ${{ matrix.lane == 'floating' && '1' || '0' }}
        ACCESS_ROUTER_REACT_REPORT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/react-consumer-reports
      run: |
        mkdir -p _tmp-node24-access-router-react
        git check-ignore _tmp-node24-access-router-react
        export TMPDIR="$PWD/_tmp-node24-access-router-react"
        export ACCESS_ROUTER_REACT_CONSUMER_NODE="$(asdf where nodejs 24.0.0)/bin/node"
        "$ACCESS_ROUTER_REACT_CONSUMER_NODE" --version
        pnpm --filter @web-ts-toolkit/access-router-react test:packed-consumer

    - name: Save resolved dependency evidence
      if: always()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
      with:
        name: react-minimum-node-${{ matrix.lane }}
        path: ${{ runner.temp }}/react-consumer-reports
